claim.text: Hazard became closing at 5.9 s, and impact occurred at 8.0 s, 2.1 s later.
The hazard onset reason was closing, so the struck vehicle was already in the ego lane closing.
Perception took 0.1313 s, below the 0.3 s threshold.
Command took 0.6329 s, above the 0.1 s threshold.
Actuation took 0.3 s, below the 0.45 s threshold.
With nominal timings of 0.2 s perception, 0.05 s command and 0.35 s tau, contact is avoided with a 2.8297 m minimum gap.
The road surface was dry, corroborated by the independent recheck observation.
Brake log is complete, so the timing results are reliable.
